description: This file defines utility functions 'prepare' and 'urlFor' for constructing URLs with dynamic parameters and query strings within the OrangeHRM system. It appears to be used for generating endpoint URLs dynamically based on parameters and global configuration.
external_files: <window.appGlobal> (assumed to be a global variable in the environment)

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Constructs a URL string by replacing placeholders in the endpoint with parameters and appending query string parameters, including handling array values.

methods.name: urlFor
methods.description: Generates a complete URL by concatenating a base URL from a global object with the output of 'prepare', customizing the endpoint with parameters and query string.
